test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. Only two people sit between E and F when counted from the left of F. G sits third to the left of K. C sits to the immediate right of K. C sits second to the left of E. B is not an immediate neighbour of G.

Who sits third to the right of B?
solution:
Given: B, C, D, E, F, G and K are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) Only two people sit between E and F when counted from the left of F.

2) C sits second to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ddc7a4e81df9bec28487edbeec30db8287b06d51f46661864d426efc5be536b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc0ed0a4d482819efb099b874fca965b954b1b255bd498326e5b8585379cc3b3.png] 

3) C sits to the immediate right of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1049ee69a06abc4281744fdb0faffa48949ed535fc2002a853bcdd8670c944f6.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be95559ebb128ea235324b0e5632c0c01300731edd8a6e24e2f2e517769421c3.png] 

4) G sits third to the left of K.

5) B is not an immediate neighbour of G.

After positioning B and G only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5233927fd3dd688c3440e45f8606e5f82fc0e4378ea8f7fbfbeada4d4330a7be.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64717087e15f2de11fa71bc117665db3b9ff490fa50ef7b273e3d3f5fd4e85ce.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, D sits third to the right of B.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
